note: On the east shore of Lake Dunmore below Mount Moosalamoo, with a 1,000-ft natural sand beach, boat rentals and a concession stand; VT 53 splits the park. The beach-side sites ring an open grassy area with the day-use lawn and bathhouse between them and the beach; the wooded side across the road is mostly tent and lean-to sites on a narrow, twisty loop. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA site list/season dates + 2026 map: 36 tent/RV (23 RV-capable: 17 beach side, 6 wooded side), max 35 ft, 17 sites 24 ft+; no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump, water. Season 2nd weekend May-2nd Mon Oct (05-14/10-11 for 2027; RA sells to Oct 16). fcfs some_sites cleared. Fees $20/$38 (+$2 prime) confirmed. Pin at the VT 53 junction between the halves: no move. Website .html -> /parks/branbury.
